id.description: Unique identifier for the polymer chain. Can be either a single letter (A-Z) or a PDB-style ID (4 alphanumeric characters)

residue_index.description: The index of the binding contact in the target chain.

id.description: A chain ID for the ligand

ccd.tooltip: A Chemical Component Dictionary ID (1-5 uppercase letters/numbers).

constraint_type.description: Specifies this is a pocket constraint

molecule_type.title: Molecule Type

modifications.description: Modifications to the sequence at a specific residue.

structural_templates.description: Structural templates to guide prediction. Only allowed for protein molecules.

StructuralTemplate.description: A structural template to guide protein structure prediction.

structure.description: The template structure content in CIF or PDB format

name.title: Name

chain_id.description: Optional chain ID to use from the template structure. If not specified, the best matching chain will be automatically selected based on sequence similarity.
chain_id.title: Chain Id
chain_id.tooltip: Specific chain ID to use from the template. Leave empty for automatic selection.

StructuralTemplate.title: StructuralTemplate

complex_id.description: Optional ID for this complex, analogous to the OSS Boltz input YAML/JSON filename stem (record.id). Used as the artifact folder under $NIM_OUTPUT_PATH (e.g. 8ibx/{confidence_scores,pae,pde}/) and in written filenames (confidence_8ibx_model_0.json). When omitted, artifacts go under prediction_{timestamp}/.
complex_id.title: Complex ID
complex_id.tooltip: ID of the predicted complex. Matches OSS output folder naming when set; otherwise a timestamped prediction_* folder is used.

polymers.description: A list of polymers (DNA, RNA, or Protein). Maximum 12 polymers allowed.
polymers.title: Polymers

ligands.description: A list of Ligands. Maximum 20 ligands allowed.
ligands.title: Ligands
ligands.tooltip: An optional list of up to 20 ligands.

constraints.title: Constraints
constraints.tooltip: A list of constraints, which are either pockets or bonds.

recycling_steps.description: This parameter controls the number of times the models output is fed back into the network for further refinement. Increasing the number of recycling steps can lead to a more accurate and refined final structure prediction as the model has more opportunities to converge on an optimal solution. However, each recycling step increases the overall computation time. Recommended for: Difficult or large protein complexes where initial predictions may need iterative improvement. Tip: For faster, preliminary assessments, a lower number of recycling steps can be used. For final, high-quality predictions, consider increasing this value.
recycling_steps.title: Recycling Steps
recycling_steps.tooltip: Controls the number of recycling steps; higher numbers may improve accuracy at the cost of higher runtime.

sampling_steps.description: This setting determines the number of discrete steps the diffusion model takes to generate the 3D structure from an initial noisy state. In each step, the model removes a certain amount of noise to progressively build a coherent and accurate molecular structure. Higher values: Generally result in a more detailed and higher-quality structure, but at the cost of longer processing times. Lower values: Lead to faster generation but may produce a less refined or lower-quality output. A sufficient number of sampling steps is crucial for the diffusion process to effectively denoise and generate a valid structure.
sampling_steps.title: Sampling Steps
sampling_steps.tooltip: Controls the number of sampling steps for each diffusion sample; higher numbers may improve accuracy at the cost of higher runtime.

diffusion_samples.description: This parameter specifies the total number of independent structures the model will generate. Each sample is created from a different random initial noise distribution, leading to a potential diversity of final predictions. Generating multiple samples is useful for exploring different possible conformations of a structure and assessing the model's confidence and consistency.
diffusion_samples.title: Diffusion Samples
diffusion_samples.tooltip: Controls the number of attempted structures. Increases runtime linearly with the number of structures.

max_parallel_samples.description: Maximum diffusion samples processed concurrently. Leave unset to use the BioNeMo Inference Runtime default.
max_parallel_samples.title: Max Parallel Samples
max_parallel_samples.tooltip: Lower values reduce GPU memory usage but increase runtime.

step_scale.description: This parameter adjusts the magnitude of change applied at each sampling step during the diffusion process. It influences the aggressiveness of the denoising at each iteration. Larger scale: The model takes larger steps in refining the structure. This can speed up convergence but risks overshooting optimal atomic placements, potentially leading to a less accurate or even distorted final structure. Smaller scale: The model takes more cautious, smaller steps. This can lead to a more precise and stable refinement process, but may require more sampling steps to reach a high-quality result.This parameter essentially modulates the trade-off between the speed of structure generation and the fine-grained accuracy of the final atomic coordinates.
step_scale.title: Step Scale
step_scale.tooltip: The step scale between each sampling / recycling step. Larger steps may be faster but less accurate. A number between 1 and 2 is recommended.

without_potentials.title: Run Without Potentials
without_potentials.tooltip: Run the model without factoring in potentials.

output_format.description: The output format of the returned structure.
output_format.title: Output Format

concatenate_msas.description: Concatenate Multiple Sequence Alignments for a polymer into one alignment.
concatenate_msas.title: Concatenate MSAs
concatenate_msas.tooltip: When set, all input MSAs are concatenated into a single input for each polymer.

sampling_steps_affinity.description: The number of sampling steps to use for affinity prediction. Higher values may improve accuracy but increase runtime.
sampling_steps_affinity.title: Affinity Sampling Steps
sampling_steps_affinity.tooltip: Controls the number of sampling steps for affinity prediction; higher numbers may improve accuracy at the cost of higher runtime.

diffusion_samples_affinity.description: The number of diffusion samples to use for affinity prediction. Higher values may improve reliability but increase runtime.
diffusion_samples_affinity.title: Affinity Diffusion Samples
diffusion_samples_affinity.tooltip: Controls the number of diffusion samples for affinity prediction; higher numbers may improve reliability at the cost of higher runtime.

affinity_mw_correction.description: Whether to add the Molecular Weight correction to the affinity value head.
affinity_mw_correction.title: Affinity MW Correction
affinity_mw_correction.tooltip: Enable molecular weight correction for affinity prediction.

write_full_pae.description: Whether to save the full PAE (Predicted Aligned Error) matrix as compressed .npz files under $NIM_OUTPUT_PATH/{complex_id}/pae/ (or prediction_{timestamp}/pae/ when name is omitted). Matrices are not included in the JSON response.
write_full_pae.title: Write Full PAE
write_full_pae.tooltip: Enable to write full PAE matrices under $NIM_OUTPUT_PATH as .npz files.

write_full_pde.description: Whether to save the full PDE (Predicted Distance Error) matrix as compressed .npz files under $NIM_OUTPUT_PATH/{complex_id}/pde/ (or prediction_{timestamp}/pde/ when name is omitted). Matrices are not included in the JSON response.
write_full_pde.title: Write Full PDE
write_full_pde.tooltip: Enable to write full PDE matrices under $NIM_OUTPUT_PATH as .npz files.
